messages:
maya: Quick sync — sketching a "storm absorber" for canary/A-B rollouts. Goal: keep SLOs steady during traffic spikes or variant regressions by letting a compact control-plane policy decide short, cheap fallbacks executed in the dataplane. Want feedback on interface boundaries and tradeoffs.

alex: sounds useful. curious: where does probing live? cadence? extra RTTs?

maya: probe lives as a lightweight async task in the dataplane. control-plane sends policy; runtime emits probe results. cadence configurable per-route (default 1s), probes are small (2-3 token warmups / health pings) to limit RTT.

sam: watch blast radius — if policy flips many tenants at once, telemetry/cost will spike. need rate limits and per-tenant caps.

chris: agree. prefer control-plane to be authoritative for policy but runtime keeps a tiny local cache. Make the decision API opaque: runtime asks "what action for snapshot X?" returns action id + TTL. minimize distributed consensus.

maya: exactly. proposed dataplane API: a single, idempotent call so runtime doesn't evaluate DSL locally. Example: /decideAction(route, metricsSnapshot, probeResults) -> {actionId, fallbackVariant, ttl}  — if actionId==0 -> no-op.

kevin: how do we guarantee rollback safety? What if a bad policy flips mid-flight?

maya: safety layers: 1) policy change goes through staged rollout (canary policy), 2) on-change preconditions (min-sample, min-qps), 3) runtime-side safety: action TTL + immediate revert if error spike exceeds threshold.

chris: nice. keep the runtime trust minimal: enforce execute-only actions. The control-plane should version actions so runtime can log actionId->policyVersion mapping for audits.

maya: sketch of policy DSL (very small):
```
policy storm_absorb_v1 {
  trigger {
    latency(mean)>200ms || error_rate(p50)>5%
    sample_window: 30s
  }
  action {
    type: variant_swap
    target: variant-b
    ttl: 60s
    guard: min_qps>50
  }
  fallback {
    type: degrade
    reductions: {tokens: 0.7, streaming: off}
  }
}
```

sam: love the DSL shape. need tenant scoping + quota checks enforced before action to avoid cross-tenant starvation. Also ensure metrics source is authenticated/validated.

alex: observability thoughts: each decision should emit a compact event: policy_id, action_id, route, probe_snapshot, reason_code. Also counters for decisions/sec and revert_count.

maya: will add telemetry contract. runtime will keep a circular log (last N actions) and expose metrics to console.

deploy-bot: policy storm_absorb_v1 applied->eu-west (group: runtime-eu-1) :white_check_mark:

kevin: test plan? chaos simulations + regression tests. Need a harness that can simulate probe noise and overlapping canaries.

maya: agreed. next steps: (1) spec control-plane RPC and versioning, (2) minimal DSL + policy store (encrypted), (3) runtime decideAction API + telemetry contract, (4) simulation harness + perf budget.

sam: +1. can we add a 'dry-run' mode that logs decisions without executing for 24h before flipping?

maya: yes — dry-run + staged rollout by percent. scheduling RFC follow-up on Wed 10am. owners: maya (arch), chris (runtime), alex (observability), sam (safety), kevin (test harness).
